provider: Wayback Machine — Save Page Now 2 (capture API)

free_tier.stated: No storage quota; the cap is per-object at 2GB ('Max resource size = 2GB') and 100,000 captures/day for authenticated users (4,000/day anonymous in the 2022 spec). Retention is effectively permanent.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.notes: extracted from the quota or limits prose

retention.stated: No storage quota; the cap is per-object at 2GB ('Max resource size = 2GB') and 100,000 captures/day for authenticated users (4,000/day anonymous in the 2022 spec). Retention is effectively permanent

egress.terms: Free, via web.archive.org replay with Range support

tooling: SPN2 REST API (POST https://web.archive.org/save, job_id polling); wrappers palewire/savepagenow, akamhy/waybackpy, overcast07/wayback-machine-spn-scripts
chaining: Serve each artifact from a throwaway host, capture it, and you hold a permanent free copy + URL: 100k captures/day x 2GB theoretical. In practice bounded by concurrency (12 concurrent authenticated).
limits_note: 2GB max resource; 10s connect timeout; 50s capture / 2m total; 12 concurrent captures (authenticated), 6 anonymous; 10 captures per URL per day; redirects max 3; robots-blocked URLs rejected; delay_wb_availability=1 defers visibility ~12h.
